## 🎮 What changed?

Describe the change and which game/file it affects.

## 💡 Why?

Explain the bug being fixed or improvement being added.

## 🧪 Testing

Describe how you tested the change.

### Checklist

- [ ] The affected game starts without a traceback
- [ ] Menus and basic controls still work
- [ ] I tested the changed feature in a normal play session
- [ ] Save/load still works if applicable
- [ ] Restart/menu behavior still works
- [ ] I added any new dependency to `requirements.txt`
- [ ] I did not include local save files or private information
- [ ] I kept unrelated changes out of this PR where possible

## 📸 Screenshots

If the change affects the UI or gameplay visuals, add before/after screenshots here when useful.

## 📝 Extra notes

Anything else reviewers should know.
